text: In Lean 4 metaprogramming, a `macro` rule differs from a `syntax` + `elab` pair primarily because:
choices: macros operate in the kernel while elaborators run in the type checker
macros perform syntactic rewriting before elaboration, while elaborators have access to the full elaboration monad and unification
macros cannot produce tactics but elaborators can
macros run at runtime while elaborators run at compile time
explanation: Macros are pure syntax transformers (Syntax → MacroM Syntax). Elaborators have access to the full MetaM/ElabM monad — unification, type inference, tactic proof states.
